what_this_resolves: The protocol froze on 2026-08-24 with execution_status CANNOT_CHECK and a recorded tooling_gap: 'opa, cedar, cosign, in-toto-verify, in_toto, slsa-verifier all absent from PATH; no Docker; lane constraints forbid network installation.' Its stated unblock was 'an environment permitted to install the pinned binaries runs this protocol unchanged'. This artifact pins those binaries in such an environment.
what_this_does_NOT_do: It does not execute the protocol. No slot is filled and no native verdict is recorded.
It does not tick either issue-1086 P8 box. Installing the tools is the precondition, not the campaign.
It re-decides nothing about scope: the 4 systems, 12 ordered pairs, 24 slots and acceptance criteria are unchanged.

execution_environment.note: Compute-node outbound egress was verified independently before install.

pinned_binaries.install_route: cargo install cedar-policy-cli --locked, built from source
pip install in-toto into the pinned venv

install_note_recorded.observation: LUNARC's newest Rust module is 1.76.0. cedar-policy-cli 4.12.0 requires rustc 1.89 or newer, and 3.4.3 fails on a transitive dependency requiring the edition2024 Cargo feature, unsupported by Cargo 1.76.
install_note_recorded.resolution: A user-space toolchain was installed via rustup and cedar-policy-cli 4.12.0 was built from source against it.
install_note_recorded.why_recorded: The build path is part of the binary's identity. A reader reproducing this cannot use the site Rust module and should not discover that by failing.
